First day of testing. A-10 was able to influence Subject B-1 to sit in a chair and pick up a slate. B-1 reported disorientation and confusion that lasted for the duration of the test and approximately fifteen minutes later. Vitals and cognition testing were all normal.

A-10 reported a severe headache, specifically where the neuroamp is implanted. Started A-10 on standard pain management regimen.

UPDATE: Upping pain management to include stronger anti-inflammatory medication. Scans indicated swelling at the neuroamp location.
items.legacy_ko:
